researchTasks: [Medium] Consumer vs Enterprise data controls, age, retention and output rights: Please provide Enterprise retention schedule, model/provider list, Australian data residency, learner age conditions and output ownership/licensing. (route: Perplexity Enterprise sales; evidence wanted: Enterprise terms, DPA, Trust Center, subprocessor list)

Confirm current pricing, market availability, integrations/standards, accessibility, security evidence and commercial relationship. Complete blank AI fields from current vendor terms/help/trust documentation; record a separate source per field.
Ask vendor (How long prompts and chats are kept): Please provide retention schedule, complete subprocessors and distinguish Enterprise from consumer account data use.
Ask vendor (Who processes the data): Please provide retention schedule, complete subprocessors and distinguish Enterprise from consumer account data use.
Ask vendor (AI models used): Please identify the current model names/version or state explicitly that models are proprietary/in-house or not disclosed. Please map models to AI features.
Ask vendor (Staff can review AI output before learners see it): Can staff review AI-generated content before learners see it or before grades/feedback are released?
Ask vendor (Staff can set limits on the AI): Can administrators/educators set topic, prompt, feature, or access restrictions?
Ask vendor (Staff can see learner conversations): Can staff see learner conversations? Which roles can access them, and can this be disabled?
Ask vendor (How it responds to learners): Is the AI designed to coach learners with questions/hints, follow educator-defined behaviour, or provide direct answers? Can this be configured?
Ask vendor (Who owns what the AI produces): Who owns generated outputs and what licence does Perplexity retain in user inputs and outputs?
Researcher note (dataPrivacy), not shown until sourced: Enterprise customer data is not used to train, fine-tune or improve models; consumer settings and account terms differ.
Researcher note (learnerOversight), not shown until sourced: Terms require users to be at least 13; minors below age of majority need parent/guardian acceptance.
Researcher note (outputOwnership), not shown until sourced: Privacy and training controls vary by plan and settings; exact retention, age and output rights require verification.
